facts.about: Trent Ltd is engaged in retailing of apparels, footwear, accessories, toys, games, food, grocery & non food products through various of its retail formats/ concepts.

flags.text: Operating leverage: profit +63%/yr vs sales +35%/yr over 3 years
Operating margin expanded 5 pts in 3 years (14% → 19%)
Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 123% of PAT
Latest quarter growth (+22%) well below 3-yr trend (+35%)

business.summary: Trent Ltd is a lifestyle retailer operating brands like Westside, Zudio, Samoh, and Burnt Toast. It generates revenue through a direct-to-consumer model, offering fashion, beauty, and lifestyle products across physical stores and digital channels.

segments.name: Fashion and Lifestyle
segments.note: Includes Westside, Zudio, Samoh, and Burnt Toast brands.

segments.name: FMCG (Star)
segments.note: Own brands contribute over 70% of revenues in Star business.

narrative.scoreline: Management has demonstrated exceptional execution, delivering significant margin expansion and cash flow growth despite a recent deceleration in revenue momentum.
bull: Operating margins expanded 5 percentage points in 3 years, reaching 19% in FY26.
Cash conversion is elite, with CFO at 123% of PAT over a 5-year period.
Revenue has scaled from ₹8,242 cr to over ₹20,000 cr in just three fiscal years.
bear: Revenue growth slowed to 14.8% in Dec 2025 before a slight recovery to 21.9% in Sep 2026.
Latest quarter growth of 22% remains significantly below the 3-year average trend of 35%.
Contingent liabilities for taxes and various claims remain a persistent risk on the balance sheet.
watch: Sustainability of 18-19% margins as revenue growth stabilizes in the 20% range.

risks.text: Contingent liabilities exist for indirect taxes, income tax, and various claims against the company.
Transactions with related parties are conducted at arm's length in the ordinary course of business.
Inventory existence is a key audit matter due to high volumes across many locations.
